About Plumeria

Planned with care,
celebrated together.

Plumeria Event Planners is an event planning team based in Mavelikara, Alappuzha, Kerala. From planning to execution, we bring stage and venue decor, catering, light and sound, studio coverage, cars, makeup, music and anchoring together for your celebration.

Booking is open for 2026–27, and we offer our services all over the country.

Our services

Ten ways we make your
event complete.

Choose one service or bring several together under one team.

01

Stage & Venue Decor

We create beautiful and elegant stage and venue decorations tailored to the theme of your special occasion. From traditional wedding stages to modern luxury setups, we transform venues into memorable spaces.

02

Catering

Delight your guests with quality food and professional catering arrangements. We help organize catering for weddings, receptions and special events, including traditional Kerala-style dining.

03

Light & Sound

Create the perfect atmosphere with professional lighting and sound arrangements for weddings, receptions, stage programmes and celebrations.

04

Studio Packages

Capture your special moments with photography and studio-related event packages, with professional visual coverage of your celebration.

05

Premium & Vintage Cars

Add elegance to your special occasion with premium and vintage car arrangements for weddings and other celebrations.

06

Bride & Groom

We help coordinate beautiful wedding arrangements for the bride and groom, focusing on presentation, comfort and memorable moments.

07

Makeup

Professional makeup arrangements to complement your special occasion, with attention to the desired style and event requirements.

08

Choir

Organized choir arrangements to bring a special musical atmosphere to weddings and celebrations.

09

Music Band

Music band arrangements to make events more lively and entertaining, depending on the occasion and requirements.

10

Anchors

Professional anchoring arrangements to coordinate programmes, entertain guests and keep events organized.
